Final-Year Project · UET Peshawar · Digital Twin Prototype v0.1

Low-Head Hydropower from the KP Irrigation Network — a working twin of your canal system

Feasibility study and analysis of low-head hydropower generation from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's irrigation network. This twin mirrors the 21 canal reaches in your own progress-report tables — real design discharges, lengths and command areas — and lets you test what-if heads, efficiencies and flow conditions on each reach before the sourced site heads arrive.

21 reaches · 2 canal systems Physics: P = ρgQHη Irrigation veto built in Scenario model — outputs are what-if, not measured generation

Read the totals honestly: branches and minors are off-takes of the main canal, so the same water appears in several reaches. Summing every reach at one scenario head is an upper-bound screening figure, not additive generation — in a real cascade, each fall can only use the drop at its own structure, once.

What turns this prototype into the real twin

Three data sets slot straight into the sliders above — no rebuild needed.

From the Irrigation Department

Sourced net head per fall

Seasonal head at each candidate structure replaces the head slider with a measured value, reach by reach. This is the single missing number behind every power figure in the FYP.

From the Warsak follow-up list

Structure list with chainage

Which falls, regulators and drops exist on each reach, and where (RD / chainage) — so a scenario head is attached to a real structure, not a whole canal.

From the Irrigation Department

Release & closure schedule

Actual seasonal releases and closure periods replace the flow presets and set a defensible capacity factor, instead of an assumed one.

P (kW) = 9.81 × Q (m³/s) × H (m) × η  ·  E (MWh/yr) = P × 8,760 × CF ÷ 1,000  ·  1 cusec = 0.0283168 m³/s  ·  ρ = 1,000 kg/m³, g = 9.81 m/s²

Discharges, lengths, C.C.A and off-take points are transcribed from the Lower Swat Canal System and Kabul River canal tables in your FYP progress-report uploads. Heads are not in those tables — every power and energy figure on this page is a scenario computed from the head, efficiency, flow and capacity factor you set, screened by the 1.0 m minimum-head rule and the irrigation veto. Nothing here is a measured or promised output. Prototype built for the 6 November 2026 second progress presentation.
